main_argument_chains.claim: Continuous addition provides the preferred corrected strategy under the paper's mean-temperature and water-use criteria.
support_steps: Compare mean temperature and water amount.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: State the comparison horizon, corrected loss assumptions, and water accounting before recommending a strategy.

main_argument_chains.claim: Spatial nonuniformity is reduced by distributed inflow entrances.
support_steps: Compare one, two, five, and whole-side entrances.
Observe more even fields with more entrances.
Recommend distributed inflow as an implementation improvement.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use spatial field evidence and a feasible faucet design rather than relying on the mean alone.

main_argument_chains.claim: Heat-loss sensitivity depends on exposed area, person/motion interface, bubble resistance, humidity, and radiation.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Recommendations must identify which factor changed and preserve the held-constant assumptions.
